name: Arabian Gulf Door Est
headline: Arabian Gulf Door Est. | Industrial Doors & Entrance Solutions UAE
lede: Leading supplier of roller shutters, automatic doors, dock levellers & high-speed doors in Dubai & UAE. Expert installation & maintenance services.
about: Arabian Gulf Door Establishment (AGE UAE) is a trusted supplier and installer of advanced industrial doors, entrance automation systems, loading bay equipment and access control solutions in Dubai and across the UAE. We provide high-quality products engineered for commercial buildings, warehouses, factories, logistics facilities, retail outlets, airports and residential properties.

At Arabian Gulf Door Establishment (AGE UAE), we provide complete end-to-end service solutions to ensure your door systems operate safely, efficiently and without interruption. From initial installation to ongoing maintenance and emergency repairs, our expert team is committed to delivering reliable and high-performance results.
